issue_request: FHIR-19464 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core change request from the FM work group, raised and applied for STU3, asking whether VisionPrescription.reason[x] was needed and resolving to remove the reason code element.

additional_context: FHIR-18032 was resolved Not Persuasive because FHIR-19464 was approved, confirming that the intended outcome was removal rather than adding terminology. FHIR-18031 is same-family context because it mentioned adding reason to summary, but FHIR-19464 controls the reason element. VisionPrescription is active in fhir.ini and now assigned to OO. No direct Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with the Jira/source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current active StructureDefinition has no VisionPrescription.reason[x] element, the examples have no reasonCodeableConcept or reasonReference content, and the VisionPrescription search-parameter bundle has no reason search parameter.
